# AI Motion Lab

AI Motion Lab creates AI video, motion design, 3D product visuals, advertising videos, animated covers, and visual packs for brands, bloggers, producers, agencies, and businesses.

Main site: https://aimotionlab.ru/
Language: Russian
Market: Russia
Contact: hello@aimotionlab.ru

Important pages:
- https://aimotionlab.ru/ai-video-for-business.html — AI video for business, Reels, Shorts, Stories, and social advertising
- https://aimotionlab.ru/ai-ads-for-business.html — AI advertising videos for business
- https://aimotionlab.ru/video-iz-foto-dlya-biznesa.html — practical article about making a short advertising video from one business photo
- https://aimotionlab.ru/korotkiy-rolik-petlya-vk-shorts.html — practical article about short loop videos, retention, comments, VK Clips, and YouTube Shorts

Services:
- AI advertising videos for Reels, Shorts, Stories, and social ads
- Motion design packs for creators and brands
- 3D product visuals and packshots
- Video concepts, scripts, covers, and visual style development
